heading: Things I build
intro: Most of my side projects plug into one identity provider I wrote myself. Each one ships as a single JAR: run it with java -jar, and move from embedded H2 to Postgres or MySQL when you outgrow it.

hub.name: Portal SSO
hub.tagline: Self-hosted OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect identity provider
hub.description: Authorization code + PKCE on every client, refresh-token rotation, TOTP MFA, an append-only audit log, magic-link sign-in and an admin console, all in one jar. Ships with a drop-in npm SDK for popup or redirect login.

satellites.name: Hidenseek VPN
satellites.tagline: WireGuard VPN for you and your friends
satellites.description: Bring your own VPS (or ten). A one-line server install, per-device peers, session history, and Tauri apps for Windows, Linux and Android.

satellites.name: OpenCourier
satellites.description: Multi-tenant email, SMS, push and webhooks with provider failover. Bulk dispatches of 100k+ messages run on Java 25 virtual threads.

satellites.name: Eggless Observability
satellites.tagline: Logs & telemetry in a single JAR
satellites.description: Real-time WebSocket live tail, a Logback appender and a Spring Boot starter. Boots in under 10 seconds on an embedded database.

libraries.name: BrewQ MQ
libraries.description: Durable, Postgres-backed background jobs. Annotate a method with @Job and get retries, backoff and dead-lettering on a virtual-thread worker pool, with no Quartz XML.

libraries.name: Cipher Starter
libraries.description: Field-level encryption for JPA columns, Jackson DTOs and AOP methods. Includes blind indexing so encrypted columns stay searchable, plus Argon2id hashing and a KMS SPI.

libraries.name: TranscodeX SDK
libraries.description: Multi-threaded FFmpeg pipelines: HLS adaptive streaming, AES-128 segment encryption, thumbnails and metadata, with Spring auto-configuration.

libraries.name: Nova AI Agent SDK
libraries.description: A fluent agent API with automatic tool calling, memory, RAG and rate limiting, across OpenAI, Gemini, Claude and Ollama.

libraries.name: JMapX
libraries.description: Bytecode-level analysis of Java apps. Builds a versioned application graph with call graphs, inheritance and archive boundaries, then lets you explore it visually.

libraries.name: CoinVault
libraries.description: A peer-to-peer wallet built deliberately old-school: Servlets, JSP, stateless EJBs and JPA on TomEE 11. It keeps the legacy muscles warm.

npm.name: @tanmaysinghx/portal-sso
npm.description: Zero-boilerplate OAuth 2.1 & OIDC SSO SDK with popup login and a drop-in button.

npm.name: ts-nodify
npm.description: Scaffold an Express backend in seconds: TS or JS, Winston logging, Swagger, Docker and CI files.

npm.name: ts-code-analysis-tool
npm.description: Concurrent ESLint-powered code analysis with security checks and readable output.

maven.name: cipher-spring-boot-starter
maven.description: Transparent field-level encryption for Spring Boot, with key rotation and blind indexing.

maven.name: brewq-spring-boot-starter
maven.description: Auto-configuration, @Job method scanning and worker lifecycle for Spring Boot apps.

maven.name: brewq-core
maven.description: Framework-agnostic job model, state machine and scheduling primitives. No Spring dependency.

maven.name: brewq-store-postgres
maven.description: Postgres-backed job store using SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

maven.name: brewq-dashboard
maven.description: Web UI and REST API for job status and manual retries.
